figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 1. Selected thiopeptides, gene cluster, and known knowledge of nosiheptide biosynthesis. (A) Structures of thiopeptide antibiotics
nosiheptide, nocathiacin I, and thiazomycin E1. (B) Organization of the genes responsible for the biosynthesis of nosiheptide. Gene functions are
annotated by colored rectangular blocks. (C) Known PTMs involved in the biosynthesis of nosiheptide. Thiazoles and the side ring that are formed
during the biosynthetic process are indicated by colors.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 2. NosDEFGHO-enabled monocyclic thiopeptide formation. (A) Heterologous expression in S. lividans. Constructs (left), examination of
dehydrated intermediates (middle) and LP-NH2 (right) in S. lividans by HPLC-HR-MS. The expressed genes in S. lividans include the
combinations of the precursor peptide-encoding gene nosM with the PTM-encoding genes nosFGH + O (I) and nosDE + FGH + O (II). (B)
Dehydration process of intermediate 2 by NosDE. (C) In vitro conversion of penta-dehydrated 2−5 × H2O to the monocyclic thiopeptide 5. LP-
NH2 (left) and 5 (right) were examined after the conversion of 2−5 × H2O in the absence (I, control) and presence of NosO (II). In panels (A,C),
for HR-MS analysis of 2, 2−1 × H2O, 2−2 × H2O, 2−3 × H2O, 2−4 × H2O, or 2−5 × H2O, the dashed lines indicate the monoisotopic peaks of
ESI m/z [M + 4H]4+ (calcd 1406.8226, 1402.3200, 1397.8173, 1393.3147, 1388.8121 or 1384.3094; observed 1406.8196, 1402.3203, 1397.8175,
1393.3156, 1388.8120 or 1384.3092; and error 2.13, 0.21, 0.14, 0.64, 0.07 or 0.14 ppm). For extracted ion chromatograms (EICs), the ESI m/z [M
+ 4H]4+ modes for LP-NH2 and 2−5 × H2O are 1107.28 and 1385.06, respectively, and the ESI m/z [M + H]+ mode for 5 is 1091.12.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 3. Effects of MIA incorporation on thiopeptide framework formation. (A) Heterologous expression in S. lividans and associated HPLC-HR-
MS analyses. Left, construct for the expression of nosM + DE + FGH + IJKL + O; middle, examination of thiopeptide product (I) with standard 6
(II); and right, examination of LP-NH2 based on expressing nosM + FGH + O (I, control) or nosM + DE + FGH + IJKL + O (II). (B) Heterologous
expression in E. coli and associated HPLC-HR-MS analyses. Left: construct for the expression of nosM + DE + FGH + IJK and the genes coding for
S. actuosus tRNAGlu (CUC) and GluRS; and right, examination of MIA-containing, dehydrated intermediates with the supplementation of MIA
after 16 h (I) or 24 h (II) IPTG induction at 16 °C. (C) NosDE-catalyzed dehydration process of intermediate 3. (D) HPLC-HR-MS analysis of
the in vitro conversion of 3 to LP-NH2 (left) and 6 (right) through intermediate 3−5 × H2O. I and II, incubation of 3 in the absence (control) and
presence of NosDE; III, addition of NosO based on II; and IV, standard 6. For HR-MS analysis of 3, 3−1 × H2O, 3−2 × H2O, 3−3 × H2O, 3−4 ×
H2O, or 3−5 × H2O, the dashed lines indicate the monoisotopic peaks of ESI m/z [M + 4H]4+ (calcd 1446.0858, 1441.5832, 1437.0805,
1432.5779, 1428.0752 or 1423.5726; observed 1446.0942, 1441.5901, 1437.0880, 1432.5884, 1428.0820 or 1423.5692; and error 5.81, 4.79, 5.22,
7.33, 4.76, or 2.39 ppm). For EICs, the ESI m/z [M + 4H]4+ modes for LP-NH2, 3 and 3−5 × H2O are 1107.28, 1446.83 and 1424.32, respectively,
and the ESI m/z [M + H]+ mode for 6 is 1248.16.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 4. Effects of side ring closure on thiopeptide framework formation. (A) Heterologous expression in S. lividans and associated HPLC-HR-MS
analyses. Left, construct for the expression of nosM + DE + FGH + IJKL + O + N; middle, examination of thiopeptide product (I) with standard 7
(II); and right, examination of LP-NH2 based on expressing nosM + FGH + O (I, control) or nosM + DE + FGH + IJKL + O + N (II) For EICs, the
ESI m/z [M + H]+ mode for 7 and the ESI m/z [M + 4H]4+ mode for LP-NH2 are 1260.17 and 1107.28, respectively. (B) Transforming processes
from 3−5 × H2O to 7 through intermediate 8 (left) and from 4 to 9 through intermediate 4−4 × H2O. (C) Heterologous expression in E. coli and
associated HPLC-HR-MS analyses. Left: constructs; and right, examination of NosN-enabled transformations with the supplementation of MIA. I
and II, Overexpression of nosM + DE + FGH + IJK and nosM + DE + FGH + IJK + N respectively with the genes coding for S. actuosus tRNAGlu
(CUC) and GluRS; and III and IV, Overexpression of nosM + FGH + IJK and nosM + FGH + IJK + N, respectively. For HR-MS analysis of 3−5 ×
H2O, 8, 3 or 4, the dashed lines indicate the monoisotopic peaks of ESI m/z [M + 4H]4+ (calcd 1423.5726, 1426.5726, 1446.0858 or 1449.0858;
observed 1423.5754, 1426.5751, 1446.0883 or 1449.0962; and error 1.97, 1.75, 1.73, or 7.18 ppm).

figure_candidates.label: Figure 5
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 5. Timing of side ring closure with Ser/Thr dehydration in the
biosynthesis of nosiheptide. (A) In vitro dehydration of 4. Reactions
were conducted in the absence (I, control) and presence of NosDE
(II). For HR-MS analysis of 4 or 4−4 × H2O, the dashed lines
indicate the monoisotopic peaks of ESI m/z [M + 4H]4+ (calcd
1449.0858 or 1431.0752; observed 1449.0919 or 1431.0732; and
error 4.21 or 1.40 ppm). (B) In vitro conversion of 4−4 × H2O.
Reactions were conducted in the absence (I, control) and presence of
NosO (II). For EICs, the ESI m/z [M + 4H]4+ mode for 4−4 × H2O
and the ESI m/z [M + H]+ mode for 9 are 1431.82 and 1278.18,
respectively. (C) In vitro formation of the side ring system. 3−5 ×
H2O was converted in the absence (I, control) and presence of NosN
(II). For HR-MS analysis of 3−5 × H2O or 8, the dashed lines
indicate the monoisotopic peaks of ESI m/z [M + 4H]4+ (calcd
1423.5726 or 1426.5726; observed 1423.5760 or 1426.5770; and
error 2.39 or 3.08 ppm). (D) In vitro conversion of 8. Reactions were
conducted in the absence (I, control) and presence of NosO (II),
with standard 7 (III). For EICs, the ESI m/z [M + 4H]4+ mode for 8
and the ESI m/z [M + H]+ mode for 7 are 1427.32 and 1260.17,
respectively.
